summary: Comprehensive testing of Maintenance Window Scheduler feature (Iteration 169). All 20 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing confirmed DevicesSmartBar with 'Schedule Window (N)' and 'Windows' buttons, MaintenanceWindowDialog with all required elements (name, scheduled_at with preset chips, parent_ticket, 3 action toggles, description, notify_clients, device list, Schedule button), and MaintenanceWindowHistory dialog showing windows with status badges, View/Run Now/Cancel buttons, and detail view with AI Summary card and per-device results.
seed_data_creation: Test windows created during backend tests (TEST_ prefixed, cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Maintenance Window Scheduler fully functional. Backend endpoints: POST /api/maintenance-windows (create), GET /api/maintenance-windows (list with ?status= and ?limit=), GET /api/maintenance-windows/{id} (detail with runs[]), GET /api/maintenance-windows/stats/summary (no route collision), POST /api/maintenance-windows/{id}/run-now (triggers execution), DELETE /api/maintenance-windows/{id} (cancel scheduled only). Frontend: DevicesSmartBar has 'Schedule Window (N)' button (disabled when N=0) and 'Windows' button. MaintenanceWindowDialog has all required elements. MaintenanceWindowHistory shows windows with status badges and action buttons. Detail view shows AI Summary (real Claude output) and per-device results. Background scheduler logs 'Maintenance Window scheduler started' on startup.

backend_endpoints.create_window: POST /api/maintenance-windows - validates device_ids (required, max 200), actions (must be valid), scheduled_at (required ISO format). Returns window with id, name, status='scheduled', devices_meta[]
backend_endpoints.get_window_detail: GET /api/maintenance-windows/{id} - returns window with runs[] array
backend_endpoints.stats_summary: GET /api/maintenance-windows/stats/summary - returns {counts:{}, upcoming:[]} - no route collision with /{wid}
backend_endpoints.run_now: POST /api/maintenance-windows/{id}/run-now - triggers immediate execution, status goes scheduled→running→completed
backend_endpoints.cancel_window: DELETE /api/maintenance-windows/{id} - cancels scheduled windows only, returns 400 for running/completed
backend_endpoints.parent_ticket_comment: When parent_ticket_id is set, completion posts comment with kind='maintenance_window' to ticket_comments

backend_execution.run_now_triggers: Status changes to 'running', then 'completed' after execution
backend_execution.summary_counts: Completed windows have summary_counts: {ok, failed, skipped}
backend_execution.ai_summary: Real Claude Sonnet 4.5 generates post-maintenance report
backend_execution.per_device_runs: Each device+action combination creates a run record with status

frontend_devices_page.schedule_window_btn: data-testid='schedule-window-btn' - shows count of selected devices, disabled when 0

frontend_maintenance_window_dialog.scheduled_at: data-testid='mw-scheduled-at' - datetime-local input with preset chips (+2h, Tonight, +1d, +1wk)

frontend_maintenance_history_dialog.window_list: Shows windows with name, status badge, scheduled_at, device count, actions
frontend_maintenance_history_dialog.view_btn: Opens detail dialog for any window
frontend_maintenance_history_dialog.run_now_btn: Play icon, only for scheduled windows - data-testid='mw-runnow-{id}'
frontend_maintenance_history_dialog.cancel_btn: Trash icon, only for scheduled windows - data-testid='mw-cancel-{id}'
frontend_maintenance_history_dialog.detail_dialog: Shows AI Summary card (fuchsia styling) and Per-device results list
frontend_maintenance_history_dialog.ai_summary_card: Real Claude-generated post-maintenance report with bullet points

background_scheduler.startup_log: 'Maintenance Window scheduler started' logged on backend startup
background_scheduler.auto_execution: Picks up scheduled windows where scheduled_at <= now every 60 seconds

mocked_apis.per_device_action_dispatch: MOCKED - Per-device action execution is a deterministic stub (sleep 50ms + 'dispatched' record). Live TRMM fan-out available through existing ticket device list endpoint. AI summary is REAL Claude output.
